newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Arafat, Netanyahu to meet with Dutch EU presidency.
newsitem.headline: Arafat, Netanyahu to meet with Dutch EU presidency.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will visit the Netherlands on Monday to hold talks with Prime Minister Wim Kok and Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo, a Dutch government spokesman said on Thursday.

The spokesman said the visit was taking place in the context of the Netherlands' presidency of the European Union and would focus on how the EU could support the Middle East peace process following the recent Israeli-Palestinian agreement on Hebron.
Israeli Prime Benjamin Netanyahu was expected to make a similar visit to the Netherlands in mid-February but details have not yet been finalised, the spokesman said.
Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy held talks in The Hague on Thursday with Van Mierlo.
The Dutch spokesman said Levy had expressed support for a complementary role by the European Union, alongside the United States, in supporting the Mideast peace process.
Arafat has sought European Union support for the peace process as a counterbalance to U.S. backing for Israel.
For its part, the EU has been keen to play an active diplomatic role in a neighbouring region.
